sources: curricula/oknos-book.json (stages and what each lets the learner do)
grammar_order_check: Each stage lists what it may assume. A structure used before the stage that teaches it is marked as a set phrase. Verb groups use the usual names of Greek grammar teaching: A (γράφω), B1 (μιλάω), B2 (μπορώ), G1 (έρχομαι), G2 (θυμάμαι), and the AB group (ακούω, λέω, τρώω).

objectives: Read any Greek word aloud, slowly
Say where the stress falls
grammar: the alphabet, small and capital letters
letter pairs: ου, αι, ει, οι, υι, αυ, ευ, μπ, ντ, γκ, γγ, τσ, τζ
the accent mark, and words written in capitals without it
stages.words: the open-alphabet reading cards, plus 10-15 words the learner already knows from Turkish (open-shared-words-tr)

scenario.tr: Atina'da sokak tabelaları ve bir kafenin menüsü: önce harfler, sonra tanıdık kelimeler (καφές, φλιτζάνι, ταβέρνα).
scenario.en: Street signs and a café menu in Athens: first letters, then familiar words (καφές, φλιτζάνι, ταβέρνα).

stages.notes: A different shape from the other chapters: the text section is short readings of signs. The Turkish bridge is strong here: many shared words, and sounds Turkish has (ş does not exist, but ç ≈ τσ, c ≈ τζ).

objectives: Say hello and goodbye to a friend and to a stranger
Say your name and where you are from
Ask someone the same, with εσύ or εσείς
grammar: informal and formal address: σου/σας, σε/σας, είσαι/είστε, εσύ/εσείς, εσένα/εσάς
set_phrases: είμαι από + την/τη/τον/το + country (the rule is lesson 3)

scenario.tr: Dil kursunun ilk günü (samimi) ve belediyede bir memur (resmî).
scenario.en: First day of a language course (informal) and a clerk at the town hall (formal).

objectives: Say what you do and ask what others do
Introduce a friend or a colleague
Count to ten
grammar: the present of είμαι, all six persons
personal pronouns in the nominative (εγώ … αυτοί/αυτές/αυτά)
the vocative of names: Νίκος → Νίκο, κύριος Παππάς → κύριε Παππά; feminine names do not change
assumes: lesson-01: greetings, σου/σας, με λένε, είμαι από as a set phrase
set_phrases: Τι δουλειά κάνεις/κάνετε; (κάνω as a verb of its own: its forms come with the A verbs in lesson 3, its aorist and future in lesson 13)
stages.words: numbers 0-10; 8-10 professions (γιατρός, δάσκαλος/δασκάλα, φοιτητής/φοιτήτρια, μηχανικός, πωλητής/πωλήτρια, υπάλληλος); ο κύριος; ο φίλος / η φίλη

scenario.tr: Bir doğum günü partisinde Eleni, arkadaşı Mehmet'i Nikos'la tanıştırıyor; sonra Nikos'un babası Bay Pappas geliyor.
scenario.en: At a birthday party Eleni introduces her friend Mehmet to Nikos; then Nikos's father, Mr Pappas, joins them.

objectives: Say where you live and where you work
Fill in a simple form
Say on which days and how often you do something
grammar: nouns in the nominative singular and their gender: ο/η/το and the endings -ος/-ας/-ης, -α/-η, -ο/-ι/-μα
the accusative after σε and από: μένω στην Αθήνα, είμαι από την Τουρκία (the lesson-01 set phrase gets its rule)
the present of A verbs (μένω, δουλεύω, γράφω, διαβάζω)
assumes: lesson-02: είμαι in every person, nominative pronouns
stages.words: days of the week; πάντα, συνήθως, συχνά, μερικές φορές, ποτέ; numbers 11-199; μένω, δουλεύω; a few Athens neighbourhoods as names

scenario.tr: Bir kursta tanışma formu dolduruluyor: nerede oturuyorsun, nerede çalışıyorsun, hangi günler.
scenario.en: Filling in a course registration form: where you live, where you work, which days.

objectives: Give your phone number and spell your name
Talk about your work or studies
Say whether you are married and have children
grammar: the weak possessive pronouns after the noun: το όνομά μου, η δουλειά σου, ο αριθμός του/της/μας/σας/τους (and the second accent: τηλέφωνό μου)
assumes: lesson-03: A verbs, gender, accusative after σε/από
set_phrases: παντρεμένος/παντρεμένη, ελεύθερος/ελεύθερη (as forms to learn; adjectives are lesson 8)
stages.words: numbers 200-1,000; how to read a Greek phone number (69…, 210…); workplaces (γραφείο, νοσοκομείο, σχολείο, εταιρεία); σπουδάζω; family status

scenario.tr: Bir iş başvurusu telefonda: ad, numara, nerede çalıştığın, evli misin.
scenario.en: A job application by phone: name, number, where you work, whether you are married.

objectives: Say which languages you speak
Say your nationality, as a man or a woman
Talk about the people in your family
grammar: the present of B1 verbs: μιλάω, ρωτάω, αγαπάω, ξυπνάω (and the -ώ forms one hears)
stages.words: nationalities, masculine and feminine (Τούρκος/Τουρκάλα, Έλληνας/Ελληνίδα, …); languages (τουρκικά, ελληνικά, αγγλικά); family (μητέρα, πατέρας, αδελφός, αδελφή, παιδί, γιος, κόρη)

scenario.tr: Komşuyla balkonda sohbet: kaç dil konuşuyorsun, ailen nerede.
scenario.en: Chatting with a neighbour on the balcony: which languages you speak, where your family is.

objectives: Review the stages before it
grammar: a summary table: είμαι, A verbs, B1 verbs; σου/σας; possessives
stages.words: none new; the chapter points back to lessons 1-5

scenario.tr: Kurs sonunda yeni bir öğrenciyle tanışma: 1-5. derslerin hepsi tek bir konuşmada.
scenario.en: Meeting a new student at the end of term: lessons 1-5 in one conversation.

stages.notes: The try section is longer (5 checks); no new words block beyond a short list of lesson-1-5 words worth revising (the words block still needs at least one item).

objectives: Buy something at a kiosk or a bakery
Order a coffee the way you like it
grammar: the definite and indefinite article
nominative and accusative of the article (ο → τον, η → την, το → το; ένας → έναν)
the demonstrative αυτός/αυτή/αυτό
πάω: πήγα and θα πάω (1st and 2nd person singular, as forms)
stages.words: kiosk and bakery products (εφημερίδα, νερό, τυρόπιτα, κουλούρι, ψωμί); euro notes and coins; κιλό, γραμμάριο; coffee orders (φραπέ, ελληνικός, σκέτος, μέτριος, γλυκός)

scenario.tr: Sabah: önce periptero'dan su, sonra fırından tiropita, sonra kafede kahve siparişi.
scenario.en: Morning: water from the periptero, a tiropita at the bakery, then ordering coffee.

objectives: Describe a thing by its colour, size and age
Ask «which one?» and answer
grammar: adjectives of the two main groups: -ος/-η/-ο and -ος/-α/-ο, and the common exceptions
ποιος/ποια/ποιο
είμαι: ήμουν and θα είμαι (1st and 2nd person singular)
the relative που
stages.words: adjectives for people and things (ψηλός, κοντός, μεγάλος, μικρός, ωραίος, καινούργιος, παλιός, ακριβός, φτηνός); currencies; numbers 1,000-3,000,000

scenario.tr: Kaybolan bir çanta: karakolda tarif ediyorsun (ne renk, ne büyüklükte, içinde ne vardı).
scenario.en: A lost bag: describing it at the police station (colour, size, what was in it).

objectives: Buy something for the home in a shop
Describe your day in a short e-mail
Say what you do often and what you rarely do
grammar: the accusative singular of nouns
uses of the accusative: after prepositions, as object, τον/την λένε
adjectives in the accusative and agreement
ποιον/ποια/ποιο
the AB verb group
τρώω: έφαγα and θα φάω (1st and 2nd person singular)
stages.words: basic appliances (ψυγείο, πλυντήριο, κουζίνα, τηλεόραση); e-mail words; frequency adverbs (revised from lesson 3)

scenario.tr: Bir elektronik mağazasında buzdolabı almak; sonra arkadaşına günlük düzenini anlatan bir e-posta.
scenario.en: Buying a fridge in an electronics shop; then an e-mail to a friend about your day.

objectives: Say how to get somewhere by metro or bus
Invite someone and answer an invitation
Tell the time and talk about the weather
grammar: the prepositions με, σε, για, από, μέχρι/έως and their basic uses
movement verbs with prepositions (πάω στο, έρχομαι από)
βλέπω and φεύγω: είδα/θα δω, έφυγα/θα φύγω (1st and 2nd person singular)
a question word after a preposition (με ποιον; για πού;)
the accusative of time (τη Δευτέρα, το πρωί)
assumes: lesson-09: the accusative and its uses
set_phrases: έρχομαι (G verbs are lesson 13-14; here only έρχομαι, έρχεσαι as forms)
stages.words: telling the time; transport (μετρό, λεωφορείο, τρένο, ταξί, στάση); seasons and months; weather (βρέχει, κάνει κρύο/ζέστη); movement verbs

scenario.tr: Bir arkadaş seni cumartesi Pire'ye davet ediyor: metroyla nasıl gidilir, kaçta buluşulur.
scenario.en: A friend invites you to Piraeus on Saturday: how to get there by metro, and what time to meet.

objectives: Buy fruit and vegetables by the kilo
Ask the price and pay
grammar: the plural of nouns
numerals that agree (ένας/μία/ένα, τρεις/τρία, τέσσερις/τέσσερα)
πόσος in the accusative
πολύς, λίγος, αρκετός, κανένας in the accusative, and καθόλου
δίνω: έδωσα and θα δώσω (1st and 2nd person singular)
αυτός and εκείνος, singular and plural
stages.words: fruit and vegetables; supermarket products; κιλό, μισό κιλό, γραμμάρια; laiki words (πάγκος, φρέσκο)

scenario.tr: Cumartesi sabahı laiki pazarında alışveriş, sonra süpermarkette eksikleri tamamlamak.
scenario.en: Saturday morning at the laiki street market, then the supermarket for what is missing.

objectives: Review the stages before it
grammar: summary tables: the article in nominative and accusative, singular and plural; adjective agreement; the aorist and future forms met so far
stages.words: none new

scenario.tr: Bir günlük alışveriş turu: periptero, fırın, pazar, mağaza.
scenario.en: A day of errands: periptero, bakery, market, shop.

objectives: Ask for a size and a colour and try something on
Say what you like and what you don't
grammar: plural adjectives in nominative and accusative
adjective-noun agreement
κάνω: έκανα and θα κάνω (1st and 2nd person singular)
G1 verbs (-ομαι: έρχομαι, κάθομαι, χρειάζομαι)
μου αρέσει / μου πάει / μου κάνει + nominative
stages.words: clothes, shoes, accessories; colours; adjectives for clothes (στενός, φαρδύς, κοντός, μακρύς); μου αρέσει/πάει/κάνει

scenario.tr: Ermou Caddesi'nde bir mağazada pantolon denemek: beden, renk, uydu mu.
scenario.en: Trying on trousers in a shop on Ermou Street: size, colour, does it fit.

objectives: Read a short flat ad
Describe a flat and its rooms
Ask what there is near a place
grammar: υπάρχει/υπάρχουν and είναι + nominative
έρχομαι: ήρθα and θα έρθω (1st and 2nd person singular)
G2 verbs (-άμαι: θυμάμαι, κοιμάμαι, λυπάμαι)
a summary table of nominative and accusative uses
place adverbs + preposition: δίπλα σε, απέναντι από, κοντά σε, μακριά από
stages.words: flat descriptions: type, size (τετραγωνικά), floor, rooms, furniture, appliances; ordinal adjectives (πρώτος … δέκατος); verbs for directions (στρίβω, προχωράω)

scenario.tr: İlan sitesinde iki daire ilanı okuyup emlakçıyı aramak, sonra daireyi gezmek.
scenario.en: Reading two flat ads online, calling the agent, then viewing the flat.

objectives: Order food by phone or at a taverna
Book a table
Say what you will do
grammar: the simple future (θα + perfective stem) of A verbs and irregular verbs
assumes: lessons 7-14: the 1st and 2nd person future forms met as single forms now become a system
stages.words: phrases used with the future (αύριο, το Σαββατοκύριακο, την άλλη εβδομάδα); souvlaki and taverna menu

scenario.tr: Telefonla souvlaki siparişi, sonra hafta sonu tavernada bir masa ayırtmak.
scenario.en: Ordering souvlaki by phone, then booking a taverna table for the weekend.

objectives: Book a hotel room by phone
Check in at the reception
Talk about the plan of a trip
grammar: the simple future of B1, B2 and G verbs
personal pronouns in the accusative, weak and strong (με/εμένα, σε/εσένα, τον/αυτόν …)
assumes: lesson-15: the simple future of A verbs
stages.words: hotel words (δωμάτιο, μονόκλινο, δίκλινο, κράτηση, ρεσεψιόν, πρωινό)

scenario.tr: Naxos'a bir hafta sonu gezisi: telefonla oda ayırtmak ve otele giriş.
scenario.en: A weekend on Naxos: booking a room by phone and checking in.

objectives: Arrange an evening out with friends
Ask whether you may do something
Ask someone to do something, or not to
grammar: the simple subjunctive (να + perfective)
verbs followed by να (θέλω, μπορώ, πρέπει, ξέρω)
μην
different subjects: θέλω να πας
assumes: lesson-16: perfective stems of all verb groups
stages.words: music, cinema, theatre; adjectives of origin (ελληνικός, τουρκικός, γαλλικός)

scenario.tr: Mesajlaşma: arkadaşlar cuma akşamı açık hava sinemasına gitmeyi ayarlıyor.
scenario.en: Text messages: friends arrange an open-air cinema on Friday night.

objectives: Review the stages before it
grammar: summary tables: the future and the subjunctive side by side; weak pronouns
stages.words: none new

scenario.tr: Bir arkadaşın Atina'ya gelecek: nerede kalacak, ne yapacaksınız, ne giymeli.
scenario.en: A friend is visiting Athens: where they will stay, what you will do, what to wear.

objectives: Write a friend a short message about your holiday
Say what you did yesterday or last week
grammar: the aorist of A verbs and irregular verbs (all persons)
the aorist of B1 and B2 verbs
assumes: the 1st and 2nd person aorists met in lessons 7-14 as single forms
stages.words: words used with the aorist (χθες, πέρσι, πριν από δύο μέρες, την περασμένη εβδομάδα); holiday words (παραλία, νησί, πλοίο, κολύμπι)

scenario.tr: Tatilden dönüşte bir arkadaşa mesaj: nereye gittin, ne yaptın, nasıl geçti.
scenario.en: Back from holiday, a message to a friend: where you went, what you did, how it was.

objectives: Choose a mobile phone plan
Do a simple task at the bank or the post office
grammar: weak genitive pronouns as indirect objects (μου δίνετε, σας στέλνω) and after prepositions
feminine nouns in -ση, -ξη, -ψη (η κράτηση, η πράξη, η λήψη)
assumes: lesson-16: weak pronouns in the accusative
stages.words: banking (λογαριασμός, κάρτα, ΑΦΜ, ΙΒΑΝ, ανάληψη, κατάθεση); post office (δέμα, συστημένο, γραμματόσημο); mobile plan words

scenario.tr: Bankada hesap açmak (AFM ve kimlik istenir), sonra postaneden koli göndermek.
scenario.en: Opening a bank account (they ask for your AFM and ID), then sending a parcel at the post office.

objectives: Say how you feel when you are ill
Talk to a pharmacist or a doctor
Understand and give instructions
grammar: the simple imperative
the imperative with weak pronouns (πάρ' το, δώσε μου)
negative commands (μην + subjunctive)
adverbs in -α and -ως
stages.words: illnesses, symptoms, medicines, health centres (κέντρο υγείας, φαρμακείο); the body; medical tests; specialists

scenario.tr: Ateşin var: önce eczaneye, sonra sağlık merkezinde doktora.
scenario.en: You have a fever: the pharmacy first, then the doctor at the health centre.

objectives: Give the right wish on a birthday, a name day or a holiday
Describe how a holiday is celebrated
grammar: the genitive of nouns, singular and plural
uses of the genitive: possession, street names, age, date, origin
conditional clauses (αν)
time clauses (όταν, πριν, μόλις)
stages.words: wishes (χρόνια πολλά, καλό Πάσχα, καλά Χριστούγεννα, να τα εκατοστήσεις); holiday words

scenario.tr: Komşunun isim günü ve Paskalya: ne denir, ne yapılır.
scenario.en: A neighbour's name day, and Easter: what to say and what people do.

stages.notes: Customs feed the A2 + history exam; keep facts general and correct, and leave dates of movable feasts out.

objectives: Talk about your study and work plans
Describe a job and what it offers
Compare two things and give reasons
grammar: όταν, αν, που
purpose clauses (για να)
causal clauses (γιατί, επειδή)
concessive clauses (αν και, παρόλο που)
the comparative and the relative superlative of adjectives
comparative adverbs
stages.words: education (πανεπιστήμιο, πτυχίο, σεμινάριο); work (μισθός, ωράριο, άδεια, συνάδελφος)

scenario.tr: İki iş teklifini karşılaştırmak: maaş, saatler, yol; bir arkadaşa hangisini seçtiğini anlatmak.
scenario.en: Comparing two job offers (pay, hours, commute) and telling a friend which you chose.

objectives: Review the stages before it
grammar: summary: the aorist, the imperative, the genitive, the clause types
stages.words: none new

scenario.tr: Bir yıl sonra kurs arkadaşına uzun bir e-posta: neler yaptın, işin, sağlığın, bayramlar.
scenario.en: A year later, a long e-mail to a classmate: what you did, work, health, holidays.

objectives: Read a formal notice and answer it in about 150 words
Report what someone said
grammar: the passive voice in the present and the aorist
conditionals beyond αν + present
linking a 150-word text
stages.words: from the open-b1-bridge pack and the coach's B1 items

scenario.tr: Bir belediye duyurusu ve buna verilecek 150 kelimelik resmî bir cevap.
scenario.en: A municipal notice and a formal 150-word reply to it.

stages.notes: Not part of the book: this chapter is written from the B1 blueprint, and is the most important to review against the exam guide.
